title: 第13章 赏识
content_zh:
陆凤台很快得到消息，并迅速作出反应。
“怎么回事？被偷的那人查了没有？是不是我们要找的逃犯？”
“不是。”冯胜应道：“那人名叫武烔，前不久才加入英略社，武艺很高，说话结巴。该是李瑕误以为他是大理人，所以让人去接触。”
陆凤台不悦，问道：“李瑕只是昨日与英略社那些人闲聊了几句，就能够锁定武烔？”
“但他找错了，武烔并非大理人，乃是庐州巢县人。”
“我不管他是不是找错了，为何樊三昨夜告诉我的聊天内容没有这些？”
“樊三刚开始离李瑕并不近，直到李瑕与人比试才凑了过去……”
陆凤台摇了摇头，道：“不，这只能说明，李瑕这小子不简单，你们没留意到的东西他都留意到了。”
“是。”
“那偷儿呢？”
“名叫白茂，已转押到我们这边了，还在审……”
陆凤台道：“我亲自去审。”
他眉头皱得渐渐深起来，一路大步而行。
待到了牢房中，见到白茂，陆凤台却不似那些凶狠的手下，反而露出温和的神色来。
一会儿之后……
陆凤台问道：“你是说，你娘亲被聂仲由捉了？”
白茂道：“是，他他……他捉了小人的娘亲，逼小人偷偷……偷东西。”
“哈，他还是这般性子，何必这般逼迫别人卖命呢？”陆凤台叹道，“你放心吧，我会向上头汇禀，派人往临安府一趟把你娘亲放出来，可好？”
白茂一愣，喃喃道：“真的？”
“我向来不骗豪杰义士。”

白茂感激涕零，重重一磕头，道：“小人愿为陆都头效死。”
陆凤台道：“我不需你效死，只要你把知道的一切都告诉我就可以。”
“是，是，小人一定全招。”
待陆凤台离开牢房，却见樊三快步走了上来。
“你来做什么？不是让你盯着李瑕吗？”
樊三脸上显出羞愧之色，低下头，拱手道：“都头，我跟丢了……”
“跟丢了？”陆凤台脸色一变，问道：“有没有让人快去找？”
“是，已把人手都散出去了。”
“呵，好个李瑕，好个聂仲由。”
樊三道：“只怕那李瑕才是真正要与逃犯联络之人，也许他已找到那些逃犯，这才故意让那偷儿吸引我们的视线？”
陆凤台摇了摇头，道：“此事没这么简单。”
又过了一会儿，却有手下人匆匆过来，道：“找到李瑕了。”
“在哪？”
“他回了承平客栈，让聂仲由出面到县衙给白茂作保，要把白茂保出来……”
陆凤台听了，有些自嘲地笑了笑，摇了摇头，眼神中的沉思之色愈浓。
这天傍晚，他再次回到承平客栈后面的那间茶楼，目光看去，远远地能看到客院当中李瑕正在那里蹦蹦跳跳做奇怪的动作，还有个小丫头坐在石桌上剥鸡蛋。
好不容易等李瑕忙完，就见他坐在那吃东西、聊天，那小丫头很开心的样子，手舞足蹈的。
其后，聂仲由领着白茂回来，李瑕起身拍了拍白茂的肩，往客栈外走去。
陆凤台想了想，吩附樊三在茶楼上继续盯着客栈，他自己则站起身，也往外走去……
庐州城北有一片湖泊，名叫“逍遥津”，三国时，张辽曾在此大破孙权，威震天下。

李瑕上午跑步时路过此地，觉得这边风景颇好，于是傍晚又过来散步。
他站在湖边看着水光潋滟，手里拿着一根黄瓜“咔嚓”一声吃了一口。
身后有“咔嚓”的轻响声传来，陆凤台踩碎了地上的落叶，走了过来。
李瑕侧头看了陆凤台一眼，也没说话，又咬了一口黄瓜。
“我也不绕弯子了，直说吧。”陆凤台道：“你找到了那几个大理人了没有？”
“没有。”
陆凤台道：“我必须尽快找到他们，否则此事或要让蒙人找到借口南侵，你可知这半年来蒙人多次挑衅，若非各方忍辱负重，淮右可能早便生灵涂炭了？”
李瑕吃完最后一口黄瓜，伸手入怀，掏出那枚铜牌，在陆凤台眼前一晃，问道：“想要吗？”
陆凤台一愣之后苦笑了一下，却不伸手去接。
李瑕道：“今天我在街上举着这个铜牌，大理高氏应该已经看到我了，他们还看到官差把我的同伴捉走。
那么，你拿走这个铜牌也没用，因为他们如果看不到我，会以为我也被你捉了，那他们是不敢出来的。”
陆凤台道：“我听说你本是一个死囚，是聂仲由把你带出来，让你替他做事？”
“对。”
“帮我吧？”陆凤台道：“你知道我才是对的，几个高氏余部根本成不了事。而淮右才是抗蒙的主要战场。”
他抬手指了指逍遥湖，道：“庐州不仅有这一个湖，南面还有一个大湖，巢湖，巢湖南可截天堑长江，西与大别山形成掎角之势，东可威胁建康府。
一旦蒙军拿下庐州，便可在巢湖训练水师，则长江天堑不再能挡住蒙军，临安指日可破！可问题是，眼下淮右这形势……我敢断言，一旦开战，淮右战场一战既溃！”
说到这里，陆凤台叹息了一声，又道：“北面那边也不是所有人都想南下的，我可以告诉你，有人对节使保证会尽力斡旋、延缓蒙军攻宋，眼下是重要时候，万不可生乱。”
李瑕道：“这些道理我不懂。”
“但你是聪明人，你知道何事大，何事小。”陆凤台道：“帮我找到那些大理逃犯，交出去，不过是几个异族人，却可缓燃眉之急。”
李瑕沉默着。

陆凤台道：“我都听白茂说了，你不像聂仲由那个死脑筋，你懂取舍。你在死牢里杀了两个犯人，在长江上杀了水匪，这些我都知道，我很欣赏你。”
他说着，朝天拱了拱手，忽然问道：“你知道余都帅吗？”
李瑕摇头，道：“不知道。”
“余都帅少时在茶馆与人发生口角，不慎失手推对方致死，于是逃到淮左，投在时任淮东制置使的赵相公幕下。正是因为赵相公的一力提拔，他才屡立战功，之后镇守蜀地、屡破蒙军，为大宋在这危难之际撑住半壁江山！
李瑕，你现在的处境不正像余都帅当年？都是不慎杀人，落难奔走。而我已把你的事迹告诉节使，他非常赏识你，你若愿投淮右军中，谁知来日不能成为一个为国守土、威震天下的名将？”
陆凤台说话的时候始终盯着李瑕，眼神很诚挚，语气极富感染力。
李瑕想了想，似有些犹疑起来。
陆凤台再问道：“你可知聂仲由背后的吕太尉是何人？”
“不知。”
“吕文德其人战功赫赫、为我大宋立下汗马功劳不假，但如今他日渐跋扈，投靠奸相，贪婪成性。就在这江淮，吕家产业遍地，富可极矣。这等人说西南形势吃紧，挪用江淮军饷，把亏空栽到大理国这事上面，能信吗？安知他不是收了大理义军的礼物，这才派人相帮，却罔顾国事。”
李瑕道：“你说的这些离我太远，我只知道我答应了聂仲由替他办事，这是承诺。”
“这不是承诺，是他逼迫你的。”陆凤台道：“我们才是对的，帮我吧，然后留在淮右军中，我们会帮你洗脱罪名，让你堂堂正正活着，而不会逼着你去北面送命。”
李瑕再次沉默。
陆凤台劝道：“你还很年轻，当留有用之躯报国，而非为一些无益之事轻送性命。”
李瑕道：“但我父亲还在聂仲由手中。”
陆凤台闻言笑了笑，道：“放心，并不是只有聂仲由在临安府有靠山，我会救你父亲出来。”
“那好。”李瑕干脆利落地应了一句。
“爽快。”陆凤台朗笑一声，眼神中的欣赏之意更浓。
他通过白茂的招供，对李瑕已经有了很深的了解，知道李瑕不是婆婆妈妈的人，不会扯七扯八。
果不其然，李瑕把铜牌收进怀里，踱了两步，径直开口说起来。

“长丰巷那处宅子，我认为高氏余部一定会盯着，等待聂仲由派人与他们接应。所以我昨天一直呆在那，今天又在附近亮了这牌子。
我是故意让白茂被捉的，一则为的是让高氏警惕，二则也是制造混乱，找机会甩掉了跟踪者。但我本以为我甩掉跟踪者之后高氏会与我接触，奇怪的是，他们没有……”
陆凤台没有问这是真的还是假的，他表现出了对李瑕足够的信任。
“我明天可以再给你创造机会，让高氏以为你没被监视。”
“不，这太假了。你还是继续派人监视我，我自己设法甩脱便是。”李瑕摇了摇头，道：“只要他们还在城内，我相信他们必已看到了我亮出铜牌，会和我联系。”
“他们必还在城内。”陆凤台道：“但我只怕时间来不及，这案子有期限。”
李瑕微微皱眉，问道：“你为何断定他们在城内？”
陆凤台没有回答，反问道：“聂仲由有没有告诉你那些人的特点？”
“他所知有限，此事原是由蒋兴负责的，没想到蒋兴在长江被水匪杀了。我目前只知道大理高氏有五人逃到庐州。”
“四个。”
“四个？”
陆凤台想了一会，注视着李瑕的眼睛，最后还是说道：“我已经捉到了一个，只剩四个在逃，所以，我敢断言他们还在城内……”
content_en:
Lu Fengtai quickly got the news and responded quickly.
"What's going on? Has the person who was stolen been checked? Is he the fugitive we are looking for?"
"No." Feng Sheng responded: "The man's name is Wu Zong. He just joined the Yinglue Society not long ago. He is very skilled in martial arts and stutters in speech. Li Xia must have mistakenly thought that he was from Dali, so he asked people to contact him."
Lu Fengtai was displeased and asked, "Li Xia was able to target Wu Zong just by chatting with the people from Yinglue Society yesterday?"
"But he made a mistake. Wu Zong is not from Dali, but from Chaoxian County, Luzhou."
"I don't care if he found the wrong one, why didn't the chat content Fan San told me last night include this?"
"Fan San was not close to Li Xia at first, but it wasn't until Li Xia competed with others that he got closer..."
Lu Fengtai shook his head and said, "No, this can only show that Li Xia is not a simple boy. He has noticed everything you haven't noticed."
"Yes."
"What about Thief?"
"My name is Bai Mao. He has been transferred to our custody and is still being interrogated..."
Lu Fengtai said: "I will go to the trial myself."
His frown gradually deepened as he strode forward.
When he saw Bai Mao in the cell, Lu Fengtai did not look like those fierce men, but showed a gentle expression.
After a while...
Lu Fengtai asked: "You mean, your mother was captured by Nie Zhongyu?"
Bai Mao said: "Yes, he...he captured the villain's mother and forced the villain to secretly...steal things."
"Ha, he still has such a temper, why would he force others to sacrifice their lives like this?" Lu Fengtai sighed, "Don't worry, I will report it to the superiors and send someone to Lin'an Mansion to release your mother, okay?"
Bai Mao was stunned and murmured: "Really?"
"I never lie to heroes and martyrs."
Bai Mao burst into tears of gratitude, kowtowed heavily and said, "I am willing to die for Lu Dutou."
Lu Fengtai said: "I don't need you to die, as long as you tell me everything you know."
"Yes, yes, the villain will definitely do it all."
When Lu Fengtai left the cell, he saw Fan San walking up quickly.
"What are you doing here? Aren't you being asked to keep an eye on Li Xia?"
Fan San had a look of shame on his face, lowered his head, cupped his hands and said: "Tou, I lost you..."
"Lost?" Lu Fengtai's expression changed and he asked, "Have you sent someone to look for him quickly?"
"Yes, all the people have been dispersed."
"Oh, what a good Li Xia, what a good Nie Zhongyou."
Fan San said: "I'm afraid that Li Xia is the one who really wants to contact the fugitives. Maybe he has found those fugitives, and then he deliberately let the thief attract our attention?"
Lu Fengtai shook his head and said, "This matter is not that simple."
After a while, one of his men came over in a hurry and said, "We found Li Xia."
"Where?"
"He returned to Taiping Inn and asked Nie Zhongyou to come to the county government office to guarantee Bai Mao. He wanted to bail out Bai Mao..."
After hearing this, Lu Fengtai smiled somewhat self-deprecatingly and shook his head, the look of contemplation in his eyes getting stronger.
That evening, he returned to the teahouse behind Taiping Inn again. Looking around, he could see Li Xia jumping around and making strange movements in the guest house, and a little girl sitting on the stone table peeling eggs.
After finally waiting for Li Xia to finish his work, he saw him sitting there eating and chatting. The little girl looked very happy and danced.
Afterwards, Nie Zhongyou led Bai Mao back. Li Xia stood up, patted Bai Mao's shoulder and walked out of the inn.
Lu Fengtai thought for a while, then ordered Fan San to continue staring at the inn from the teahouse, while he stood up and walked out...
There is a lake in the north of Luzhou City called "Xiaoyaojin". During the Three Kingdoms period, Zhang Liao defeated Sun Quan here and shocked the world.
Li Xia passed by this place while jogging in the morning and thought the scenery here was quite good, so he came for a walk in the evening.
He stood by the lake and looked at the glimmering water, holding a cucumber in his hand and "clicking""I took a bite."
There was a soft "click" sound behind him. Lu Fengtai crushed the fallen leaves on the ground and walked over.
Li Xia glanced sideways at Lu Fengtai, said nothing, and took another bite of cucumber.
“I won’t beat around the bush, let’s just say it. Lu Fengtai said: "Have you found those Dali people?" "
"No. "
Lu Fengtai said: "I must find them as soon as possible, otherwise this matter may give the Mongols an excuse to invade south. Did you know that the Mongols have provoked many times in the past six months. If all parties had not endured the humiliation and shouldered the burden, Huaiyou might have been ruined long ago?" "
Li Xia finished the last bite of cucumber, reached into his arms, took out the bronze medal, flashed it in front of Lu Fengtai's eyes, and asked, "Do you want it?" "
Lu Fengtai was stunned for a moment and then smiled bitterly, but did not reach out to pick it up.
Li Xia said: "Today I was holding this bronze medal on the street. The Gao family in Dali should have seen me, and they also saw the officials arresting my companions.
Well, it's useless for you to take away this bronze medal, because if they can't see me, they will think that I have been caught by you, and then they will not dare to come out. "
Lu Fengtai said: "I heard that you were a death row prisoner, and it was Nie Zhongyou who brought you out and asked you to do things for him? "
"right. "
"Help me? Lu Fengtai said: "You know I am right. A few remnants of the Gao family can't accomplish anything at all." Huaiyou was the main battlefield against Mongolia. "
He raised his finger and pointed at Xiaoyao Lake and said: "Luzhou not only has this lake, but also a large lake to the south, Chaohu Lake. Chaohu Lake cuts the Yangtze River in the south, forms a corner with the Dabie Mountains in the west, and threatens Jiankang Prefecture in the east.
Once the Mongolian army captures Luzhou, they can train the navy in Chaohu Lake. Then the Yangtze River natural moat can no longer block the Mongolian army, and Lin'an can be broken in a day! But the problem is, the current situation in Huaiyou... I dare to say that once the war starts, the Huaiyou battlefield will be defeated in one battle! "
At this point, Lu Fengtai sighed and said: "Not everyone in the north wants to go south. I can tell you that someone has promised the envoy that they will try their best to mediate and delay the Mongolian army's attack on the Song Dynasty. This is an important time and no chaos can occur. "
Li Xia said: "I don't understand these principles. "
“But you are a smart man, you know what is big and what is small. Lu Fengtai said: "Help me find those Dali fugitives and hand them over. They are just a few foreigners, but they can alleviate the urgent need." "
Li Xia was silent.
Lu Fengtai said: "I have heard what Bai Mao said, you are not like Nie Zhongyou who is stubborn, you know the choice. You killed two prisoners on death row and a water bandit on the Yangtze River. I know all this and I admire you very much. "
As he spoke, he raised his hands toward the sky and suddenly asked: "Do you know Yu Du is handsome? "
Li Xia shook his head and said, "I don't know. "
"When Yu Dushuai was young, he had an argument with someone in a teahouse and accidentally pushed the other person to death. So he fled to Huaizuo and surrendered to Zhao Xianggong, who was the envoy of Huaidong at that time. It was precisely because of Zhao Xianggong's promotion that he repeatedly made military exploits. Later, he guarded Shu and repeatedly defeated the Mongolian army, supporting half of the Song Dynasty in this crisis!
Li Xia, isn't your current situation the same as that of Yu Dushuai? They all accidentally killed people and ran away in distress. And I have told the envoy about your deeds, and he appreciates you very much. If you are willing to join the Huaiyou Army, who knows that you will not become a famous general who defends the country and is powerful in the world one day? "
Lu Fengtai always stared at Li Xia when he spoke, his eyes were sincere and his tone was very contagious.
Li Xia thought for a while and seemed to be hesitant.
Lu Fengtai asked again: "Do you know who Lieutenant Lu is behind Nie Zhongyou? "
"I don't know. "
"Lü Wende has made great achievements in battle and has made great contributions to the Song Dynasty. But now he is becoming increasingly domineering, taking refuge in the treacherous prime minister, and is greedy. Right here in Jianghuai, the Lu family has properties all over the place and is extremely wealthy. Can these people believe that the situation in the southwest is tense and they misappropriated military funds from the Jianghuai River and put the shortfall on Dali Kingdom? I know he didn't accept a gift from the Dali Rebels.Things, so they sent people to help, but they ignored national affairs. "
Li Xia said: "What you said is too far away from me. I only know that I promised Nie Zhongyou to do things for him. This is a promise. "
“This is not a promise, he forced you. "Lu Fengtai said: "We are right, help me, and then stay in the Huaiyou Army. We will help you clear your name and let you live upright, instead of forcing you to go north to die. "
Li Xia was silent again.
Lu Fengtai advised: "You are still very young, so you should serve your country with a useful life instead of sacrificing your life for some useless things. "
Li Xia said: "But my father is still in Nie Zhongyou's hands. "
Lu Fengtai smiled when he heard this and said: "Don't worry, Nie Zhongyou is not the only one who has backers in Lin'an Mansion, I will rescue your father. "
"That's good. "Li Xia responded simply and neatly.
"Refreshing. "Lu Fengtai laughed loudly, and the appreciation in his eyes became even stronger.
Through Bai Mao's confession, he already had a deep understanding of Li Xia. He knew that Li Xia was not a mother-in-law and would not talk nonsense.
As expected, Li Xia put the bronze medal into his arms, took a few steps, and started talking.
“I think the rest of the Gao family will definitely be watching the house in Changfeng Lane, waiting for Nie Zhongyou to send someone to meet them. So I stayed there yesterday, and today I displayed this sign nearby.
I let Bai Mao be captured on purpose, firstly to alert Gao, and secondly to create chaos and find an opportunity to get rid of the pursuer. But I thought the Gao family would contact me after I got rid of the stalker, but strangely, they didn’t..."
Lu Fengtai didn't ask whether this was true or false. He showed enough trust in Li Xia.
"I can create another opportunity for you tomorrow to make Mr. Gao think that you are not being monitored. "
"No, this is too fake. You should continue to send people to monitor me, and I will try to get rid of it myself. Li Xia shook his head and said: "As long as they are still in the city, I believe they will have seen me showing off the bronze medal and will contact me." "
“They will still be in the city. Lu Fengtai said: "But I'm afraid I won't have enough time. This case has a time limit." "
Li Xia frowned slightly and asked, "Why do you conclude that they are in the city? "
Lu Fengtai did not answer, but asked: "Did Nie Zhongyou tell you the characteristics of those people? "
"What he knew was limited. Jiang Xing was originally responsible for this matter. Unexpectedly, Jiang Xing was killed by water bandits on the Yangtze River. At present, I only know that five members of the Gao family in Dali fled to Luzhou. "
"Four. "
"Four? "
Lu Fengtai thought for a while, looked into Li Xia's eyes, and finally said: "I have captured one, and there are only four left at large, so I dare to say that they are still in the city..."
